description: Create a new sub-task on a SWSD incident. Required: `incident_id`, `name`. Optional: `description` (plain text or HTML), `due_at` (ISO 8601), `assignee_email`. The created task is returned for follow-up calls. WRITE — does not retry on transient failure.

assignee_email.description: Email of the SWSD user to assign the task to.

description.description: Long-form task description. Plain text or HTML.

due_at.description: Due date / datetime in ISO 8601 (e.g., "2026-06-01" or RFC 3339).

incident_id.description: SWSD incident reference. Accepts either the internal id (>=7 digits, e.g. 180457930) or the human-facing number (<=6 digits, e.g. 60310). The handler auto-detects via digit count.

name: swsd_create_incident_task
